text:
- **Agent instructions and checks:** AGENTS.md is now a short map that Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build read in full. Every pull request now gets an automated check that grades AGENTS.md against a rubric. The check signs in without a stored API key.
- **Go test speed:** Pull requests now run only the Go tests that can differ by operating system on macOS. Main still runs all of them. The macOS test work fell, and pull requests finish sooner, but short of the targets. Work has started so each pull request runs only the Go tests its change can affect.
- **Ask-tool answers:** The store now records ask-tool questions as their own need kind. Work has started to answer these questions on the site as well as in chat. The first answer counts.
- **Agent and pm rules:** Agents now open a project, sprint or task for owner-requested work without asking leave first. The owner-request check blocks that leave request as needless. `pm sprint close` now checks only the coverage patterns a sprint added or changed. `pm check` states that close rule.
